text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Celebrations on Friday to mark Baghdad Day.
- Iraq's deputy Prime Minister Tareq Aziz returns home from a tour to Russia and Turkey.
- President Saddam Hussein sees an exhibition of gifts presented to him by Iraqis and foreign nationals on the first anniversary of extending his term of office after a presidential referendum.
- Finance Minister and acting trade minister meets with Pakistani businessmen.
(The above stories were also carried by QADISSIYA and THAWRA)
